name: 78254 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78254 (San Antonio) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78254 (San Antonio) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78254 (San Antonio) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
